title: Iframes as tiles: sizing, focus, prerender and limits
blurb: A board of iframe tiles in one canvas. Measures frame-sizing: content-height, a focus policy on embedded content, cross-origin iframe prerendering, and what the canvas gets from a cross-origin iframe.
question: Can an iframe tile in a canvas take its height from its document, be stopped from taking focus, and be drawn when it's cross-origin?
result: frame-sizing: content-height parses and does nothing in Chromium 157, so tiles are sized by message. A same-origin iframe is drawn. A cross-origin or sandboxed iframe is drawn as transparent pixels in 2D and WebGL, and still takes clicks.
